title: Behind the scenes: five notice emails to the support inbox have stopped
text: The support inbox no longer gets the daily RA renewal report, "Lease Signed", "OA Signed" / "OA Partial Sign", "Document Signed" and the "Onboarding Auto-Chain" summary. Nothing they announced is lost: the To-Do cards, tasks and What's New notes are unchanged, and the onboarding review task now lists any step that failed. A client who finishes onboarding gets the bell, the phone push and the welcome chat, but no "new update" email. Emails that carry a signed file to print (SS-4, Form 8832) or need a person (signed on paper, declined, formation re-submit) are kept.
points: RA renewal, lease, OA, document-signed and onboarding summary emails are gone
The onboarding review task now names any failed step
The client's onboarding notice no longer sends a digest email
